what: BN6's PET reads a shown power past 1000 as one of its own Navis' by MegaMan's best time (0x08010C76: the times at 0x020018C0 + 2n, the powers at 0x08020E54 + 22n, n the power less 1001), for the folder editor's card (Gregar 0x0811A874, drawn at 0x0811A878) and the pack's Attack sort (0x08121D7E); 0x08010CE0 is its twin at the step 5 (the card's where the submenu's bytes are 0x18 0x1C). The battle computes the power by 0x080109A4 instead. A moved SP's record names an entry of BN6's grown table (1128 and up), so the card read past BN6's Navis: CosmoMn SP's 6544 (issue 835). Both routines are hooked: a grown entry goes to 0x080109A4 for side 0. BN5's card (0x0812315C into 0x0800EB50: times 0x02002670, steps 0x0800EB94, powers 0x0801D27A) and BN4's (0x0801969C: times 0x02001610, steps 0x080196E0, powers 0x08018B48) are BN6's routine by their own tables, and each save's times start 0xFFFF (BN5 0x080092E0, BN4 0x08007FFA fill a side's 0x2C bytes with ~0), past every step: a card with no time shows its row's last power, which the moved routine deals with XC_SP_TIMES none (src/emu/xchips_shown.c; docs/rom/chips-code.md, its row A moved SP's power in the PET).
